full.description: This is a clinical photograph showing the hands and wrists of an individual. The image reveals visible joint deformities and swelling, along with some skin lesions and purpuric spots. These findings are characteristic of arthritic joint changes, such as those seen in severe osteoarthritis or inflammatory joint diseases. The abnormalities prominently affect the metacarpophalangeal and wrist joints.

random.description: This clinical photograph shows the hands and wrists of a patient with marked joint deformities and skin lesions. The hands exhibit ulnar deviation and subluxation at the wrists and metacarpophalangeal joints, along with overlying purpuric and erythematous macules and papules. These findings are characteristic of advanced Jaccoud's arthropathy or severe rheumatoid arthritis with associated cutaneous manifestations. The presentation reflects chronic inflammatory joint disease leading to characteristic hand deformities and skin changes.
